atoms.description: Traverse permitted public pages within explicit budgets and source policy.
Render a permitted page in an isolated browser runtime.
Convert evidence into typed records while preserving provenance.
Retry idempotent HTTP requests with bounded backoff and uncertainty handling.
Validate an authorized email candidate without manufacturing consent.
Classify buyer-intent evidence without treating it as permission or demand.
Search source code and preserve exact file/revision identity.
Inspect deployment state and logs without mutating production.
Run bounded authorized PostgreSQL queries with data-class controls.
Create a reproducible spreadsheet artifact from typed inputs.
Send an email only after canonical consent, suppression, authority, and provider gates.
Reconcile provider-origin evidence into canonical cleared-payment truth.
Parse invoice data without promoting invoice status into payment truth.
Summarize a document while preserving access to authoritative originals.
Route to an eligible configured model while preserving actual provider/model identity.
Compress context only when authoritative originals remain recoverable.
Recover subordinate working memory without overriding repository truth.
Execute a bounded test in an isolated environment with observed effects.
Evaluate generated code with deterministic and hostile tests.
Discover public capability artifacts through permitted registries and APIs.
Resolve duplicates, forks, mirrors, wrappers, and behavioral substitutes.
Require independent security and authority evidence before eligibility.
Retrieve the minimum compatible capability set for a mission.
Compare no-skill, baseline, candidate, and compositions on holdouts.
Prevent revoked capabilities from selection and preserve revocation evidence.
